summary: WORKER_TASK_SLOTS_AVAILABLE metric is stuck at zero when PollerBehaviorAutoscaling is enabled on a worker, preventing accurate reporting of available task capacity.
userImpact: Workers cannot accurately report available task slots when autoscaling is enabled, preventing proper capacity visibility and potentially affecting autoscaling decisions.
keyQuote: Workers report 0 WORKER_TASK_SLOTS_AVAILABLE when PollerBehaviorAutoscaling is enabled.
